title: Adoption and display
text:
20.04.800 Adoption and display.
A.	Fees required under this title shall be as adopted from time to time by the city council. Such fees shall be to defray the costs of review by appropriate city departments of such requests and applications, and for other administration and processing costs.
B.	Copies of all fees adopted by city council under this title shall be displayed at the offices of the zoning administrator, the executive secretary of the zoning board of adjustment, and the executive secretary of the city plan commission.
(Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
